title: plane
body:
## plane

Creates a flat parallelogram (polydata) with one corner at origin and edges running to point1 and point2, subdivided into xResolution × yResolution quadrilaterals. Use it as a probe or seed surface, for example for resampling or streamline seeds, or as test geometry. The Schemaxis defaults give a 2 × 2 square in the XY plane centred at the origin, with 10 × 10 cells.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- point1 and point2 must not be collinear with origin, or the plane is degenerate.

Native constructor: `Plane`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | This property specifies the 3D coordinate of the origin (one corner) of the plane. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[-1,-1,0]` | `[-1,-1,0]` |
| `point1` | This property specifies the 3D coordinate a second corner of the parallelogram. The line connecting this point and that specified by the Origin property define one edge of the parallelogram (its X axis). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[1,-1,0]` | `[1,-1,0]` |
| `point2` | This property specifies the 3D coordinate a third corner of the parallelogram. The line connecting this point and that specified by the Origin property define a second edge of the parallelogram (its Y axis). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[-1,1,0]` | `[-1,1,0]` |
| `xResolution` | This property specifies the number of divisions along the X axis of the parallelogram. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":4096}` | `10` | `10` |
| `yResolution` | This property specifies the number of divisions along the Y axis of the parallelogram. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":4096}` | `10` | `10` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "plane"
}
```
